snippet.title: Paranoir - Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Paranoir is an indie Visual Novel developed in Event Horizon School (Turin), set in 1851 London.
You play as an annoyed grandson trying to recall the details of your Grandpa's comedic debut detective case.

Available now on itch.io: https://eventhorizonschool.itch.io/paranoir
